info.title: Recommendation Service API
info.description: Implemented routes only. Requests go through the owning service.

servers.description: Same-origin Nginx or Angular development proxy

tags.name: Context API
tags.description: Agent context. Recommendation Service reads through User Service internal APIs.

get.description: Score descending (null last), then creation time descending and ID. Sources are independent; the same movie can exist in both.

post.summary: Create or update a recommendation by user, movie and source.
post.description: Stable record per user/movie. Agent supplies resolved UUIDs. Omitted score becomes null.
